name: What materials are best for pool house exteriors?

mainEntity.name: What materials are best for pool house exteriors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stucco, cedar siding, stone veneer, and metal roofs match Southern California architecture while resisting moisture; HardiePlank or composite trim prevents rot near pools.
